sources.label: Patches for some apps I use myself.
sources.author: jzl1
patch_list: Forces Firebase analytics and crash reporting off, ignoring the in-app privacy toggles and their defaults.
Removes the orange "Sign in" prompt below the toolbar. The account screen stays reachable from the drawer.
Stops the native anti-tamper response that spawns unbounded threads and crashes the app a few seconds after launch on a repackaged build.
Unlocks the Expert tier and disables the PairIP licence check.
